import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
SLATE = "#657786" BLUE = "#33658A" TERRA = "#C66B4E" INK = "#263238"
# Schematic choices for the otherwise unspecified rotation angle. # These are geometric construction parameters, not measured data. theta = np.pi / 6 p = np.array([1.5, 2.0]) R = np.array([ [np.cos(theta), -np.sin(theta)], [np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)], ]) p_rotated = R @ p alpha = np.arctan2(p[1], p[0]) e1_B, e2_B = R[:, 0], R[:, 1]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.8, 3.8), facecolor="white") left = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.205, 0.455, 0.665]) right = fig.add_axes([0.525, 0.205, 0.455, 0.665])
for ax in (left, right): ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.set_xlim(-1.72, 3.12) ax.set_ylim(-0.40, 3.18) ax.axis("off")
def arrow(ax, start, end, color, linewidth=1.55, scale=11, zorder=3): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=scale, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=zorder, ) ax.add_patch(patch) return patch
def frame_A(ax): arrow(ax, (0, 0), (2.85, 0), SLATE) arrow(ax, (0, 0), (0, 2.90), SLATE) ax.text(2.88, -0.10, r"$\vec{e}_1^A$", color=SLATE, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12) ax.text(0.12, 2.94, r"$\vec{e}_2^A$", color=SLATE, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(-0.12, -0.12, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=11)
def angle_arc(ax, radius, start, end, color, arrowhead=True): angles = np.linspace(start, end, 100) xy = radius * np.column_stack((np.cos(angles), np.sin(angles))) if arrowhead: ax.plot(xy[:-5, 0], xy[:-5, 1], color=color, lw=1.25, zorder=5) arrow(ax, xy[-7], xy[-1], color, linewidth=1.25, scale=8, zorder=5) else: ax.plot(xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1], color=color, lw=1.15, zorder=5)
# Passive transformation: one geometric vector, expressed in two bases. frame_A(left) axis_length = 2.90 arrow(left, (0, 0), axis_length * e1_B, BLUE) arrow(left, (0, 0), axis_length * e2_B, BLUE)
left.text(*(axis_length * e1_B + np.array([0.07, 0.10])), r"$\vec{e}_1^B$", color=BLUE, ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=12) left.text(*(axis_length * e2_B + np.array([-0.04, 0.12])), r"$\vec{e}_2^B$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=12)
projection_style = dict(lw=1.05, linestyle=(0, (3.5, 3)), alpha=0.70, zorder=1) for endpoint in (np.array([p[0], 0.0]), np.array([0.0, p[1]])): left.plot([p[0], endpoint[0]], [p[1], endpoint[1]], color=SLATE, **projection_style)
for basis_vector in (e1_B, e2_B): endpoint = np.dot(p, basis_vector) * basis_vector left.plot([p[0], endpoint[0]], [p[1], endpoint[1]], color=BLUE, **projection_style)
arrow(left, (0, 0), p, TERRA, linewidth=2.25, scale=13, zorder=6) left.text(p[0] + 0.12, p[1] + 0.09, r"$\vec{p}$", color=TERRA, fontsize=14, ha="left", va="bottom")
angle_arc(left, 0.70, 0, theta, BLUE) left.text(0.98 * np.cos(theta / 2), 0.98 * np.sin(theta / 2), r"$\theta$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12)
# Active transformation: the frame stays fixed while the vector rotates. frame_A(right) arrow(right, (0, 0), p, BLUE, linewidth=2.25, scale=13, zorder=6) arrow(right, (0, 0), p_rotated, TERRA, linewidth=2.25, scale=13, zorder=6) right.text(p[0] + 0.12, p[1] + 0.02, r"$\mathbf{p}$", color=BLUE, fontsize=13, ha="left", va="bottom") right.text(p_rotated[0] + 0.15, p_rotated[1] + 0.10, r"$\mathbf{p}'$", color=TERRA, fontsize=13, ha="left", va="bottom")
angle_arc(right, 0.56, 0, alpha, SLATE, arrowhead=False) right.text(0.79 * np.cos(alpha / 2), 0.79 * np.sin(alpha / 2), r"$\alpha$", color=SLATE, fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center")
angle_arc(right, 1.24, alpha, alpha + theta, TERRA) midangle = alpha + theta / 2 right.text(1.53 * np.cos(midangle), 1.53 * np.sin(midangle), r"$\theta$", color=TERRA, fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center")
fig.text(0.2625, 0.937, "Passive transformation", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13, fontweight="medium") fig.text(0.7525, 0.937, "Active transformation", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13, fontweight="medium")
fig.text(0.2625, 0.105, r"${}^{A}\mathbf{p} = {}^{A}\mathbf{R}_{B}\,{}^{B}\mathbf{p}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15) fig.text(0.7525, 0.105, r"$\mathbf{p}' = \mathbf{R}\mathbf{p}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15)
